text:
Sam: Heads-up — competitor launched a cheap 'Lite embeddings' tier that cuts price ~50% with lower quality. Got two PMRs and sales asking for parity. Do we try to match or lean into a differentiator?

Priya: need quick cost/infra estimate. Mirroring them likely increases GPU ops and model variants: ops overhead + quality risk.

Lena: Sales report: ACME trial asked explicitly for a cheaper embeddings option + per-route opt-in. They said: "we'll expand if there's a predictable cheaper tier and isolation for our tenant".

Jules: Suggest 2-path approach: 1) Rapid pilot: 'Embeddings Lite' profile (quantized/distilled, opt-in). 2) Product differentiator: smart re-ranking + heuristics so lower-cost path only used when safe. Acceptance criteria for pilot: cost delta >= 40% for pilot traffic and quality degradation <= 5% on our eval set.

Priya: Engineering notes: int8 quant + smaller dims looks feasible. Need benching across our representative prompt set. Also require per-tenant routing flag, billing tag, and telemetry. SLO constraint: p95 latency <= 120ms. Ops impact: likely +1 oncall rotation during launch window.

Sam: Timeline pressure from sales — they'd like a canary in 3 weeks. Realistic?

Priya: 3w is aggressive. Realistic: 6w (2w bench + infra, 2w internal canary, 2w customer canary/cleanup). If we constrain scope to an opt-in pilot and no backfill, we can target 4w.

Jules: For a 4w pilot minimal scope: quantized model artifact, per-tenant feature flag, basic telemetry (embedding_quality_score, cost_delta, latency), and rollback plan. We won't support automatic backfill or global pricing tier yet.

Sam: Fine. What's the rollout config look like?

Priya: Sample rollout toggle for pilot:
```json
{
  "feature": "embeddings_lite",
  "alpha_customers": ["acme-inc"],
  "backfill": false,
  "metrics": ["embedding_quality_score","cost_delta","p95_latency"]
}
```

Lena: ACME is willing to be alpha if we sign a slim SLA note and confirm no data leakage to other tenants.

Jules: I'll own the rollout plan + acceptance criteria. Priya owns infra + model bench. Sam will coordinate customer comms. Action items: PRD + bench ticket + infra toggle. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Created ticket #1234 - embeddings-lite-pilot (owner: Jules)

Sam: Thanks — follow-up sync Thu 09:00 to lock timeline and finalize PRD.
